A new brokerage in Birmingham

Built on experience, opened with intent.

Before opening her own doors, Alichia Webster served as an associate broker with Keller Williams Hoover. Alichia and Associates Realty is the brokerage she built next: her own name on the door, her own standard behind it.

That standard is stated plainly in the tagline she launched with, “Experience you trust, excellence you deserve.” The brokerage opened for buyers, sellers and investors across Birmingham and Hoover, and the team started growing the day after launch, when Erikka Cheatham was welcomed as the first associate.

November, in three dates.

A brokerage does not appear all at once. It is teased, opened, then staffed. Here is how this one arrived, in Alichia Webster’s own announcements.

6 November 2026

The first word

The teaser lands: a new brokerage is coming soon. Birmingham gets the name before it gets the doors.

19 November 2026

Open for business

The announcement is made in full: “Now OPEN FOR BUSINESS!” Alichia and Associates Realty is live, for buying, selling and investing.

20 November 2026

The team begins

One day after opening, the first associate is welcomed. Erikka Cheatham joins the brokerage.

Buy, sell, invest. Three conversations, one brokerage.

The launch graphic said it in three words. Each one starts the same way here: with a direct conversation with the brokerage.

Buy

Buying in Birmingham and Hoover

If you are looking to buy, this is where the conversation starts. Bring the life the home has to hold: the commute, the schools, the quiet street or the busy one. The brokerage takes it from there.

Talk about buying
Sell

Selling, with the standard stated up front

If you are thinking of selling, start with the tagline the brokerage launched with and hold it to that standard: experience you trust, excellence you deserve. Ask how your home would be presented, priced and carried to its sold moment.

Talk about selling
Invest

Investing in the area she serves

Investing was the third word on the launch graphic, alongside buying and selling. If Birmingham or Hoover is where you want to put capital to work in property, the brokerage is open for that conversation too.

Talk about investing

Birmingham, and just over the ridge, Hoover.

Alichia and Associates Realty works the Birmingham and Hoover area. Before opening it, Alichia Webster was an associate broker with Keller Williams Hoover. The new brokerage is now at work in the same ground she knows.

Warm light, brick streets, porches built for evenings. Two names, one brokerage, and a standard stated on day one.
